sections.content: In a formal naturalization interview (*honosítási beszélgetés*), speaking like a B1 user means structuring your answers clearly rather than just reciting isolated facts. Discourse connectors like *mint köztudott* ("as is well known"), *ha a földrajzi fekvést tekintjük* ("if we consider the geographic location"), and *nemcsak... hanem... is* ("not only... but also...") allow you to connect geographical, symbolic, and civic ideas into a cohesive, articulate presentation.

sections.title: Formal discourse markers for naturalization topics
rows: if we look at / consider X
from a historical / geographical point of view
not only X, but Y as well
in summary, it can be said that...
according to my view and knowledge

items.spanish: Ha Magyarország elhelyezkedését tekintjük, az ország a Kárpát-medence központjában fekszik.
items.english: If we consider Hungary's location, the country lies in the center of the Carpathian Basin.

items.spanish: Nemzeti jelképeink nemcsak a múltat idézik, hanem a jövőbe vetett hitet is kifejezik.
items.english: Our national symbols not only evoke the past, but also express faith in the future.

items.spanish: Összefoglalásképpen elmondható, hogy a hét szomszédos országgal való kapcsolat kiemelt fontosságú.
items.english: In summary, it can be stated that relations with the seven neighbouring countries are of paramount importance.

sections.content: Using formal opening formulas like *Véleményem és ismereteim szerint...* or *Ha a kérdést vizsgáljuk...* gives you a second to compose your thoughts while demonstrating polite, formal Hungarian communication skills.
